# Purpose

This R Markdown file documents the preliminary technical-analysis workflow for BDA400 Assignment 2.

# Packages

```{r setup, eval=FALSE}
library(quantmod)
library(TTR)
```

# Load Utility Functions

```{r utilities, eval=FALSE}
source("01_stock_utilities.R")
```

# Import Portfolio Data

```{r import, eval=FALSE}
stocks <- load_stock_data("portfolio.txt")
```

# Calculate Statistics

```{r statistics, eval=FALSE}
statistics <- calculate_portfolio_statistics(stocks, ma_period = 20)
print(round(statistics, 2))
```

# Display Data and Visualizations

```{r display, eval=FALSE}
source("02_display_visualizations.R")
```

# Expected Outputs

The scripts display the imported OHLCV stock data, a summary table of adjusted-close statistics, candlestick charts with volume and a 20-day simple moving average, and adjusted-close line charts with the moving average.
